title: TC001-Complete onboarding with profile criteria and a PDF/DOCX resume to reach parsed profile and initial results
description: Verifies that a signed-in user can complete onboarding by selecting region/direction/degree/visa needs, uploading a PDF/DOCX resume, and then see a parsed profile summary and initial job results.
code:
import asyncio
from playwright import async_api
from playwright.async_api import expect

async def run_test():
    pw = None
    browser = None
    context = None

    try:
        # Start a Playwright session in asynchronous mode
        pw = await async_api.async_playwright().start()

        # Launch a Chromium browser in headless mode with custom arguments
        browser = await pw.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=[
                "--window-size=1280,720",         # Set the browser window size
                "--disable-dev-shm-usage",        # Avoid using /dev/shm which can cause issues in containers
                "--ipc=host",                     # Use host-level IPC for better stability
                "--single-process"                # Run the browser in a single process mode
            ],
        )

        # Create a new browser context (like an incognito window)
        context = await browser.new_context()
        context.set_default_timeout(5000)

        # Open a new page in the browser context
        page = await context.new_page()

        # Interact with the page elements to simulate user flow
        # -> Navigate to http://localhost:3001
        await page.goto("http://localhost:3001")
        
        # -> Click the 'Sign in' link to open the login page.
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click element
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/header/nav/div[2]/a').nth(0)
        await asyncio.sleep(3); await elem.click()
        
        # -> Open the login page (navigate to /login) and wait for it to load so I can fill the email and password fields.
        await page.goto("http://localhost:3001/login")
        
        # --> Assertions to verify final state
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        assert await frame.locator("xpath=//*[contains(., 'Profile summary')]").nth(0).is_visible(), "The parsed profile summary should be visible after submitting onboarding.",
        assert await frame.locator("xpath=//*[contains(., 'Job results')]").nth(0).is_visible(), "Initial job search results should be visible after completing onboarding."]}
        await asyncio.sleep(5)

    finally:
        if context:
            await context.close()
        if browser:
            await browser.close()
        if pw:
            await pw.stop()

asyncio.run(run_test())
